means: Ledger field on a request row: how many times the provider seam asked again after a transient failure before the first chunk. Absent when 0; never sent to the model.
A short operator message sent right after a run stopped as failed (for example HTTP 502); counted apart from steering in the turn profile.

name: provider retry
claim: A chat request that fails before any chunk with HTTP 502, 503, 504, 429 or a network error is asked again at the provider seam (2 more tries, 1 s then 3 s), so a transient provider error does not end the turn.

name: stop line names how a run ended
claim: When wh say, sayfile or step returns because the run ended other than done, it prints one STOP line with the stop reason and what the page said, in text and in --json, so the operator does not read the last message to find out.

name: failed continuation is not steering
claim: The turn profile counts a short follow-up that continues a failed stop apart from steering, and reports calls before the first git commit made through the shell, so a session is not misread from tool names alone.
